The track ends are within 30 minutes walk of each other on Mt White Road.

doubts: The main way runs from Andrews Shelter to the Waimakariri River flats, where the track ends; the text says the two track ends are within 30 minutes walk of each other on Mt White Road and that it is another 30 minutes back to Andrews Shelter, so that return is not listed as a way or exit. Andrews Shelter has no feature or name entry, so it has no ref. Andrews streambed is given as a separate alternative route from Andrews Shelter to Casey Saddle, since it has its own heading; the text gives no time for it. The Casey Stream gorge alternative is mentioned only in the introduction and is not given as a way. The Trust/Poulter Hut is a detour from the original Casey Hut site (taken as a side trip, not a way), and is also listed under not_on_route. The ford at Pete Stream is read from 'From the ford at Pete Stream'; the page does not say the stream is crossed in words. The main way's time is DOC's '2 days'; no distance is given. The page's Casey Hut is taken as the new Casey Hut, the one on the main way.
